chunks: And from him, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The pregnant woman is divorced with a single divorce.
ai.seo_question: How many divorces are required to finalize the divorce of a pregnant woman in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith from Sahih al-Tusi clarifies that a pregnant woman receives a single, irrevocable divorce (taliqah wahidah), distinguishing her status from the standard three-divorce protocol. This ruling is pivotal in Shia fiqh as it establishes that her iddah concludes immediately upon childbirth, rather than after a fixed lunar month period, ensuring clarity in lineage and remarriage eligibility.
